hotels.description: The quintessential beachside escape awaits at Koh Chang, a lush island retreat in Thailand offering turquoise waters, unspoiled sands and breathtaking sunsets in abundance. A serene hideaway surrounded by tropical gardens, Dinso Resort & Villas Ko Chang, Vignette Collection by IHG offers guests everything they need to kick back and let the good times roll. Spend sun-kissed days on Klong Prao beach, the island's family-friendly swimming spot (complimentary use of kayaks and paddleboards included), venture out for island excursions or savour cocktails by the magnificent central pool. Koh Chang is Thailand without the crowds. Waterfalls, pristine beaches and jungle trails are all within easy reach, offering a tantalising mix of natural beauty and adventure for travelers seeking an authentic escape. The best part? It's easily accessible via Trat airport and a short ferry, so you'll have that secluded island feeling without the logistics. Return from adventures across the island to Asian fusion plates D_Primitive restaurant or the underwater-inspired D_Wreck for laidback dining in the sun. Whether lounging on the beach, enjoying the tropical surroundings or discovering the wonders of this Thailand hidden gem, this sanctuary is perfectly positioned for exploring Koh Chang’s untouched beauty.
